applies_to: Reputation reviews, especially new businesses and small sites
evidence: Separate missing reputation information from credible negative evidence and evaluate context.
remediation: Record what is unknown and assess other trust evidence without inventing endorsements.
do_not_infer: No reviews or few backlinks automatically means poor quality.

applies_to: Expertise, reputation, testimonials, and product-review claims
evidence: Distinguish self-description, independent evidence, visible demonstrations, and conflicts of interest.
remediation: Substantiate claims and make material relationships clear.
do_not_infer: Self-proclaimed expertise or a testimonial proves independent authority.

applies_to: High-impact advice and first-hand accounts on YMYL topics
evidence: Identify whether the page gives specialist advice or shares safe, relevant lived experience.
remediation: Obtain suitable expertise for advice; keep personal experience within supported bounds.
do_not_infer: Every mention of health or money needs identical credentials, or lived experience replaces specialist advice.

applies_to: Article and landing-page information architecture
evidence: Review whether useful main content is prominent and whether filler obstructs the primary task.
remediation: Prioritize the answer or offer, remove irrelevant padding, and place supporting material appropriately.
do_not_infer: All introductory or supporting material is filler, or a rater label is a ranking prediction.

applies_to: Articles and landing pages; judged against the reader task
evidence: Identify the useful original contribution and verify substantive claims against supporting material.
remediation: Add relevant analysis, first-hand evidence, or a clearer answer to the reader task.
do_not_infer: A citation count, long text, polished layout, or embedded video proves originality or accuracy.

applies_to: All page types; evaluate length against purpose
evidence: Review completeness and unnecessary padding, not a universal minimum word count.
remediation: Fill material gaps and remove irrelevant repetition.
do_not_infer: Google requires a word count, keyword density, or mandatory FAQ.

applies_to: Authorship where expected; organizational responsibility on commercial pages
evidence: Verify named creators, credentials, and responsibility against supplied evidence.
remediation: Correct unsupported credentials and identify the actual responsible person or organization.
do_not_infer: Every landing needs an individual byline, or an author box proves expertise.

applies_to: All reviews; especially high-impact health, financial, and safety claims
evidence: Assess the experience or expertise appropriate to the claim and whether it supports trust.
remediation: Request qualified review or narrow claims to supported experience.
do_not_infer: E-E-A-T is a single ranking factor or an official numeric authority score.

applies_to: Pages with revised publication or modification dates
evidence: Compare the revision history with the stated update date.
remediation: Use a date reflecting a meaningful content update, not cosmetic freshness.
do_not_infer: A recent date alone makes information current.

applies_to: Batch production and substantially repetitive content collections
evidence: Review intent, added value, and representative pages across the collection.
remediation: Stop low-value expansion and revise the collection around distinct reader needs.
do_not_infer: AI use, publishing volume, or a similarity threshold alone establishes abuse.

applies_to: Service, location, and keyword-variant landing-page collections
evidence: Review distinct usefulness, destinations, and the navigable site hierarchy.
remediation: Consolidate indistinguishable pages or develop a genuine differentiated purpose.
do_not_infer: Shared components or design templates are doorway abuse.

applies_to: Paid, sponsored, exchanged, or otherwise incentivized links
evidence: Inspect link qualification and obtain the commercial relationship context.
remediation: Qualify applicable advertising or sponsorship links and reject ranking-manipulation arrangements.
do_not_infer: Every outbound link is paid or every backlink is a business lead.

applies_to: Live pages intended for Google Search
evidence: Inspect the actual HTTP response, not a local file or intended deployment configuration.
remediation: Correct unsuccessful responses on intended indexable pages.
do_not_infer: An HTTP 200 proves indexing, ranking, content quality, or that staging should be public.

applies_to: Live pages intended for indexing, not intentionally excluded staging
evidence: Check supported indexable content and exclusion directives in served responses.
remediation: Correct unintended exclusion only after the owner confirms publication intent.
do_not_infer: Missing live evidence passes, or a local draft is indexed.

applies_to: Pages using structured data for a supported feature
evidence: Compare markup claims with visible content and the specific feature rules.
remediation: Correct misleading, unsupported, hidden, or unrelated markup claims.
do_not_infer: Syntactically valid JSON-LD proves truth or guarantees a rich result.

applies_to: Recommendations concerning Google AI Overviews and AI Mode
evidence: Check accessibility, useful textual content, internal discovery, and accurate markup.
remediation: Prioritize established search foundations instead of unsupported AI-specific requirements.
do_not_infer: Google requires an AI text file or special schema, or compliance guarantees AI citations.

applies_to: Pages for which video-feature eligibility is being claimed
evidence: Establish whether watching one video is the primary page purpose and review the other video criteria.
remediation: Distinguish complementary embeds from dedicated watch pages in the publication plan.
do_not_infer: Adding YouTube to a blog guarantees video indexing or changes its main purpose.

applies_to: Links intended for crawler discovery
evidence: Inspect anchor elements with resolvable href values and verify rendered behavior when needed.
remediation: Use actual navigable anchors for discovery links.
do_not_infer: An anchor alone proves its target exists or is indexed.

applies_to: Related pages in an editorial or commercial hub
evidence: Review whether contextual internal links help readers discover relevant next steps.
remediation: Add relevant connections or remove irrelevant forced links.
do_not_infer: A universal five-link quota is a Google requirement.

applies_to: Structured articles and landing pages using the selected editorial profile
evidence: Inspect semantic heading order and whether sections form a meaningful outline.
remediation: Correct heading structure and control visual size in the theme.
do_not_infer: Visual font size determines heading level or a style warning proves a ranking penalty.

applies_to: Images and diagrams; distinguish decorative and informative uses
evidence: Inspect alternative text and whether it conveys the image role in its surrounding content.
remediation: Provide an appropriate textual equivalent without keyword stuffing or redundant decoration.
do_not_infer: Every image requires nonempty alt text or a chart count proves content value.

applies_to: Editorial clarity review adapted to the approved brand voice
evidence: Review jargon, unnecessary complexity, and assumptions about what readers find easy.
remediation: Replace vague or patronizing wording with specific, direct explanations.
do_not_infer: Google developer house style replaces the client voice or constitutes a ranking requirement.
